description: Moves entities of one game into a folder (folder_id), or out of their folder (empty folder_id: back to Sound effects). In the new folder they inherit its events and stop inheriting the old folder's; their own events and sounds stay. Spends no credits, and moving again to the same folder changes nothing. Use it to reorganize after create_entity or place_scenes; find folder ids with list_folders and entity ids with get_game. To make a new group, create_folder can take the entities at once.

entity_ids.description: The entities to move, all from the same game (ids from get_game).

folder_id.description: The destination folder (from list_folders). Empty or omitted: back to the root of Sound effects.

name: move_entities
title: Move entities
